cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:db.title: Estimator - Commercial Plumbing
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:db.description: Our client is a well-established commercial plumbing contractor based in the Cleveland, Ohio area, specializing in providing high-quality plumbing services to businesses and commercial properties. They are committed to delivering exceptional customer service, innovative solutions, and maintaining the highest standards of workmanship. As they continue to grow, they are seeking a skilled and motivated Commercial Plumbing Estimator to join their team. The Commercial Plumbing Estimator will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive plumbing estimates for a wide range of commercial projects, including new construction, renovations, and tenant improvements. This role requires a strong understanding of plumbing systems, construction processes, and the ability to analyze project specifications and blueprints. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to effectively communicate with clients, project managers, and subcontractors.
responsibilities: Review and analyze project plans, specifications, and contracts to develop accurate plumbing estimates.
Prepare detailed cost estimates for commercial plumbing projects, including labor, materials, and equipment.
Collaborate with project managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to obtain quotes and pricing information.
Evaluate site conditions and scope of work to ensure all necessary work is included in the estimate.
Maintain a comprehensive understanding of local plumbing codes, regulations, and industry standards.
Present and explain estimates to clients, ensuring clear communication and addressing any questions or concerns.
Track and update project budgets throughout the bidding and construction phases.
Assist in identifying cost-saving opportunities and value engineering solutions.
Maintain organized and accurate records of estimates, bids, and related documentation.
Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, and suppliers.
Attending Job Walk Throughs
Stay up to date with industry trends, materials, and technology advancements to ensure competitive and accurate estimates.
qualifications: Minimum of 5 years’ experience as a plumbing estimator, preferably in a commercial setting.
In-depth knowledge of commercial plumbing systems, codes, and industry standards.
Proficiency in Fast Est estimating software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Strong ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
[Degree or certification] in plumbing, construction management, or a related field is a plus.
[Additional certifications or qualifications] preferred but not required.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4f56227c-69d7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Technical Support Specialist based in the United States. This is a fully remote, customer-focused technical support role within a healthcare SaaS environment. You will serve as a trusted first point of contact for professionals using an Electronic Health Records (EHR) platform. The role combines hands-on customer support with technical troubleshooting, data investigation, and SQL-based problem solving. You will diagnose issues, investigate tickets, and collaborate closely with Development teams to resolve bugs and improve the product. Your ability to translate technical concepts clearly will help customers overcome challenges and use the platform more effectively. You will also contribute to documentation, training, reporting, and continuous improvements to the overall user experience. This is an ideal opportunity for a resourceful problem solver who enjoys variety, customer interaction, and meaningful work in healthcare technology. Provide customer support: Serve as the first point of contact for users through phone, email, and other support channels, delivering timely, professional, and empathetic assistance. Manage support tickets: Receive, investigate, document, and track customer issues through to resolution while maintaining clear and thorough records. Troubleshoot technical issues: Diagnose software problems across browsers, devices, and platforms, distinguishing between user errors, software defects, and enhancement requests. Investigate data issues: Use Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio, Microsoft Access, and SQL queries to investigate and resolve customer data-related problems. Guide customers: Provide practical guidance, best practices, and remote walkthroughs using screen-sharing and other support tools to help users get the most from the application. Collaborate with Development: Escalate bugs and complex technical issues appropriately, work with developers on resolutions, and help ensure customer-impacting problems are addressed effectively. Improve the customer experience: Identify recurring friction points and recommend improvements to processes, documentation, training resources, or product functionality. Support knowledge sharing: Contribute to user and internal training materials, documentation, and resources that enable customers and colleagues to resolve common issues efficiently. Share customer insights: Gather feedback and communicate recurring themes, support trends, and product opportunities to the Customer Support leadership team. Monitor support performance: Contribute to reporting on support trends, common issues, ticket volumes, and resolution times while supporting other operational priorities as needed. Requirements: 2+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, or a related field, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues. 1+ year of experience supporting EHR or healthcare SaaS applications , with an understanding of the needs and workflows of healthcare or human services organizations. Hands-on SQL experience , including the ability to write basic queries and investigate data-related issues using relational databases. Practical Microsoft Access experience and familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio. High school diploma or equivalent required; a two- or four-year college degree is preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users. Excellent organization and attention to detail , with the ability to manage multiple support tickets, priorities, and follow-ups simultaneously. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills , with a resourceful approach to investigating unfamiliar or complex issues. Customer-oriented mindset , with the ability to build trusted relationships and turn challenging support experiences

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5023a094-4e82-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Maltese Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in India. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Maltese voice professional to help shape the next generation of AI-powered voice technology. You will contribute your vocal expertise to training and evaluating advanced language and speech models. The role combines professional voice performance with linguistic evaluation, annotation, and AI-focused quality assessment. You will help improve how AI understands and reproduces Maltese pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotion, and regional variation. Working remotely, you will collaborate with a team using cutting-edge AI tools and evolving evaluation methods. Your contributions can help create more natural, accurate, and expressive voice experiences across a wide range of applications. This is a senior freelance opportunity for someone who wants to apply their Maltese voice expertise to the future of human-AI communication. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Maltese for use in AI training and voice model development. Deliver clear, natural, expressive performances while maintaining accurate pronunciation, pacing, tone, and emotional nuance. Review and evaluate AI-generated speech outputs for linguistic accuracy, naturalness, pronunciation, and overall voice quality. Identify, annotate, and categorize errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated Maltese speech. Provide detailed expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, regional variation, and other relevant linguistic characteristics. Work with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation criteria, annotation approaches, and voice design guidelines. Apply professional voice and linguistic judgment consistently across a variety of recording and evaluation tasks. Help identify opportunities to improve the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of Maltese AI voice models. Maintain high standards of recording quality and follow technical and project-specific guidelines throughout the engagement. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in voice acting, dubbing, narration, broadcasting, or a closely related performance field in Maltese. Native-level or highly proficient Maltese language skills, with strong command of pronunciation, intonation, vocabulary, and natural spoken expression. Strong vocal control and the ability to communicate different tones, emotions, pacing, and styles authentically. Excellent listening and analytical skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, linguistic, and speech-quality issues. Exceptional attention to detail and consistency when reviewing recordings and AI-generated outputs. Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when providing structured feedback and annotations. Experience with linguistic annotation, language training, voice coaching, speech evaluation, or AI training projects is a plus. Comfortable learning and working with new AI tools, recording platforms, evaluation systems, and project workflows. Reliable, self-directed, and able to manage freelance work effectively in a remote environment. Access to a high-quality recording setup, including a reliable professional-grade microphone and a quiet, controlled recording environment. Secure computer equipment and a stable internet connection suitable for remote recording and AI-related project work. Benefits Freelance contract opportunity with a remote workplace setup . southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:f26084f3.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:f26084f3.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. In order to deliver Render to our users, we must first provide the best internal developer platform for engineers to move fast, confidently, reliably, and securely along paved paths with the right set of tools, observability and guardrails. As Engineering Manager for the newly formed Platform team, you’ll lead a growing group of talented engineers — both established team members and future hires — who are energized by the opportunity to build this space alongside you. Together, you will modernize and bring Render's internal developer platform and shared production infrastructure (observability, CI/CD, developer environments, storage, and more) from good to great. Because the landscape we operate in is evolving rapidly, we build infrastructure that is modular and adaptable, able to support a product direction that is itself responding to a fast-moving market without over-indexing on any single bet. This team will have tremendous impact; unlike most infrastructure teams that build for internal consumers, our infrastructure is the product. Not only will you be enhancing the velocity and impact of your fellow Render engineers, but the 4.5 million developers using our platform as well. This role blends strong technical leadership with product thinking: you’ll partner closely with other engineering teams as well as product managers to translate user needs into high-quality, scalable systems that developers rely on every day. You’ll be responsible for guiding technical direction, developing engineers, and ensuring the team ships meaningful improvements quickly while maintaining the high standards that define Render’s platform. The ideal candidate brings a strong engineering background, a deep sense of ownership, and a passion for building products that developers love. WHAT Y
